description: Constitutional repository tree governance: fail-closed admission policy, explicit whitelists and blacklists.

meta_policy.state_vs_code: Git strictly holds deterministic code and normative contracts. All dynamic captures, run reports, observed topology drift, and benchmark outcomes belong strictly in data_system/ (outside Git).
meta_policy.zero_flat_chaos: Root directories must not host unclassified flat files. Infrastructure contracts and deployment definitions must be bounded by explicit functional domains.

architectural_taxonomy.contracts_canonical: Normative machine-readable specifications and schemas belong in contracts/.
architectural_taxonomy.deploy_canonical: Host/cluster orchestration (systemd, wireguard, firewall, compose) belongs in deploy/.
architectural_taxonomy.infra_sunset: The legacy infra/ umbrella is deprecated and phased into contracts/ and deploy/.
